en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The waiting period, and the menstruation are for the women; when they claim, they would be ratified’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Waiting period and Hayd (menses) are for women. If they say something about it their words are accepted.”’
